brief:
Thousands demonstrated across the globe in solidarity with Gaza, according to Al Jazeera English, as Palestinians marked mourning ceremonies for those killed in ongoing Israeli military operations. The protests reflected international concern over the humanitarian toll of sustained strikes in the enclave.

Palestinians observed commemorative gatherings alongside the international show of support, with daily bombardments continuing to claim lives across the territory.
dek: Thousands protest worldwide in solidarity with Gaza as Palestinians mourn those being killed in daily Israeli strikes.
title: Thousands worldwide protest Gaza strikes as Palestinians mourn daily deaths
